LESSON: PRE- NUMBER ACTIVITIES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 1.1: Pre- Number Activities
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pre- Number Activities, part of NUMBERS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: How can we group objects? 2. How can we arrange objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pre- Number Activities together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: learning independently as the learner sorts and matches objects according to colour, texture, size, shape and use.

● Communication and Collaboration: Speaking engagingly skills as learner pairs objects of the same colour, size, shape, texture and use

clearly stating.

Values:
• Unity: working cooperatively together in groups to pair and match objects according to size, colour and shape.

• Respect: while working in groups’ learner appreciate diverse opinion.

• Responsibility: learners recognize their roles when collecting and sorting objects from their immediate environment

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Care for the environment as learner utilize different types of objects from the immediate environment, handle with care during sorting and

grouping and safely dispose or store them.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the skills of environmental activities to safely identify objects from the school compound.

Learning Resources

● Marbles,

● Sticks,

● Stones,

● Grains,

● Manual number chart.
